title: Air Pollution and Adult Cognition: Evidence from Brain Training
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We exploit novel data from brain-training games to examine the impacts of air pollution on a comprehensive set of cognitive skills in adults. We find that exposure to particulate matter (PM2.5)impairs adult cognitive function, and that these effects are largest for those in prime working age. These results confirm a hypothesized mechanism for the impacts of air pollution on workforce productivity. We also find that the cognitive effects are largest for new tasks and for those with low ability, suggesting that air pollution increases inequality in productivity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用脑力训练游戏的新数据，考察空气污染对成年人一整套认知能力的影响。我们发现，暴露于细颗粒物（PM2.5）会损害成年人的认知功能，且这种影响在处于黄金工作年龄的人群中最为显著。这些结果证实了空气污染影响劳动生产率的一种假设机制。我们还发现，认知效应在新任务上以及能力较低的人群中最大，这表明空气污染会加剧生产率的不平等。

title: Carbon Rollercoaster: A Historical Analysis of Decarbonization in the United States
abstract: This paper documents the evolution of US carbon emissions and discusses the main factors that contributed to the historical carbon emissions rollercoaster. We divide the discussion into four periodsup to 1920, 1920-1960, 1960-2005 and after 2005.For each period, we discuss the main drivers of national carbon emissions. We then discuss trends in carbon emissions in the electricity sector. Electricity sector emissions were initially very small, but would become the largest source of US carbon emissions over the period 1980-2015, and the largest contributor to decarbonization since 2007.In the final section, we distill lessons from the U.S. experience that may inform decarbonization strategies in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 本文梳理了美国碳排放的演变历程，并讨论了导致历史上碳排放“过山车式”波动的主要因素。我们将讨论分为四个时期：1920年以前、1920至1960年、1960至2005年以及2005年以后。对于每个时期，我们讨论全国碳排放的主要驱动因素。随后，我们讨论电力部门碳排放的趋势。电力部门的排放起初非常少，但在1980至2015年间成为美国最大的碳排放来源，并且自2007年以来是脱碳的最大贡献者。在最后一节，我们总结了美国经验中的若干教训，这些教训可能为发展中经济体的脱碳战略提供参考。

title: HIStory of LAND Transformation by Humans in South America (HISLAND-SA): Annual and 1-km Crop-Specific Gridded Data (1950–2020)
abstract: South America is a global hotspot for land use and land cover (LULC) change, marked by dramatic agricultural land expansion and deforestation. Developing high-resolution, long-term crop-specific data is essential for gaining a deeper understanding of natural-human interactions and addressing the impacts of human activities on regional biogeochemical, hydrological cycles, and climate. In this study, we integrated multi-source data, including high-resolution remote sensing data, model-based data, and historical agricultural census data, to reconstruct the historical dynamics of four major commodity crops (i.e., soybean, maize, wheat, and rice) in South America at annual time scale and 1 km×1 km spatial resolution from 1950 to 2020. The results showed that cropland in South America has expanded rapidly through encroachment into other vegetation over the past 70 years. Specifically, soybean is one of the most dramatically expanded crops, increasing from essentially zero in 1950 to 48.8 Mha in 2020, resulting in a total loss of 23.92 Mha of other vegetation (i.e., forest, pasture/rangeland, and unmanaged grass/shrubland). In addition, the area of maize increased by a factor of 2.1 from 12.7 Mha in 1950 to 26.9 Mha in 2020, while rice and wheat areas remained relatively stable. The newly developed crop type data provide important insights for assessing the impacts of agricultural land expansion on crop production, greenhouse gas emissions, and carbon and nitrogen cycles in South America. Moreover, these data are instrumental for developing national policies, sustainable trade, investment, and development strategies aimed at securing food supply and other human and environmental objectives in South America and other regions. The datasets are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14002960 (Xu et al., 2024).
abstract_zh: 南美洲是土地利用和土地覆盖（LULC）变化的全球热点地区，其特征是农业用地的急剧扩张和森林砍伐。开发高分辨率、长时间序列的作物专题数据，对于深入理解自然与人类的相互作用、评估人类活动对区域生物地球化学循环和水文循环以及气候的影响至关重要。在本研究中，我们整合了多源数据，包括高分辨率遥感数据、基于模型的数据以及历史农业普查数据，重建了南美洲四种主要大宗作物（即大豆、玉米、小麦和水稻）从1950年到2020年的历史动态，时间尺度为年度，空间分辨率为1 km×1 km。结果表明，过去70年间，南美洲的耕地通过侵占其他植被而迅速扩张。具体而言，大豆是扩张最为剧烈的作物之一，其种植面积从1950年的基本为零增长至2020年的4880万公顷，导致其他植被（即森林、牧场/草地以及未经管理的草地/灌丛）总计减少2392万公顷。此外，玉米种植面积从1950年的1270万公顷增长至2020年的2690万公顷，增长了2.1倍，而水稻和小麦的种植面积则基本保持稳定。新开发的作物类型数据为评估农业用地扩张对作物产量、温室气体排放以及碳和氮循环的影响提供了重要依据。此外，这些数据有助于制定国家政策以及可持续的贸易、投资和发展战略，以保障南美洲及其他地区的粮食供应，并实现其他人类与环境目标。数据可在 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14002960 获取（Xu et al., 2024）。

title: Measuring Criticism of the Police in Local News Media Using Large Language Models

title: New Frontiers in Research on Industrial Decarbonization
Bridging the Gap: Mismatch Effects and Catch-Up Dynamics Under a Brazilian College Affirmative Action Program
Canary in a Coal Mine: Infant Mortality and Tradeoffs Associated with Mid-20th Century Air Pollution
abstract: Pollution is a common byproduct of economic activity. Although policymakers should account for both the benefits and the negative externalities of polluting activities, it is difficult to identify those who are harmed and those who benefit from them. To overcome this challenge, our paper uses a novel dataset on the mid-20th century expansion of the U.S. power grid to study the costs and the benefits of coal-fired electricity generation. The empirical analysis exploits the timing of coal-fired power plant openings and annual variation in plant-level coal consumption from 1938 to 1962, when emissions were virtually unregulated. Pollution from the burning of coal for electricity generation is shown to have quantitatively important and nonlinear effects on county-level infant mortality rates. By 1962, it was responsible for 3,500 infant deaths per year, over one death per thousand live births. These effects are even larger at lower levels of coal consumption. We also find evidence of clear tradeoffs associated with coal-fired electricity generation. For counties with low access to electricity in the baseline, increases in local power plant coal consumption reduced infant mortality and increased housing values and rental prices. For counties with near universal access to electricity in the baseline, increases in coal consumption by power plants led to higher infant mortality rates, and lower housing values and rental prices. These results highlight the importance of considering both the costs and benefits of polluting activities, and suggest that demand for policy intervention may emerge only when the negative externalities are significantly larger than the perceived benefits.
abstract_zh: 污染是经济活动常见的副产品。尽管政策制定者应同时权衡污染性活动的收益与负外部性，但要识别哪些人受到危害、哪些人从中获益却十分困难。为应对这一挑战，本文利用一套关于20世纪中叶美国电网扩张的新数据，研究燃煤发电的成本与收益。实证分析利用了1938至1962年间燃煤电厂的开业时间以及工厂层面煤炭消耗量的逐年变化，这一时期的排放实际上几乎不受监管。结果显示，发电用煤燃烧产生的污染对县级婴儿死亡率具有数量上重要且非线性的影响。到1962年，它每年导致3500名婴儿死亡，即每千名活产婴儿中超过一人死亡。在煤炭消耗量较低的情况下，这些影响甚至更大。我们还发现燃煤发电存在明确的权衡取舍。对于基线时用电普及率较低的县，本地电厂煤炭消耗量的增加降低了婴儿死亡率，并提高了房屋价值和租金。对于基线时几乎实现全面用电普及的县，电厂煤炭消耗量的增加则导致婴儿死亡率上升，房屋价值和租金下降。这些结果凸显了同时考虑污染性活动成本与收益的重要性，并表明只有当负外部性显著大于人们所感知的收益时，对政策干预的需求才可能出现。

title: The Historical Impact of Coal on Cities
abstract: Historically coal has offered both benefits and costs to urban areas. Benefits include coal's role in fueling industry and thus employment. The primary costs are air pollution and its impact on human health. This paper starts by using a Rosen-Roback style model to examine how differences in local coal availability affect equilibrium city employment. Drawing on the model, the paper surveys papers that examine the net effects of coal on the growth in city population and air pollution on health. The paper then turns to papers that explicitly consider the trade-offs between production benefits and pollution disamenities across space and over time. The paper ends with a discussion of opportunities for future work on coal and cities in historical settings.
abstract_zh: 从历史上看，煤炭给城市地区带来了收益，也带来了成本。收益包括煤炭为工业提供动力从而创造就业。主要成本则是空气污染及其对人体健康的影响。本文首先运用Rosen-Roback式模型，考察当地煤炭可得性的差异如何影响城市的均衡就业。基于该模型，本文综述了考察煤炭对城市人口增长净效应以及空气污染对健康净效应的相关文献。随后，本文转向那些明确考虑生产收益与污染负效用在空间和时间上权衡取舍的文献。最后，本文讨论了未来在历史背景下研究煤炭与城市问题的若干机会。

title: The Impact of Lead Exposure on Fertility, Infant Mortality, and Infant Birth Outcomes
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: The Value of Health Insurance during a Crisis: Effects of Medicaid Implementation on Pandemic Influenza Mortality
Unmasking the Role of Remote Sensors in Comfort, Energy and Demand Response
abstract: In single-zone multi-node systems (SZMNSs), temperature controls rely on a single probe near the thermostat, resulting in temperature discrepancies that cause thermal discomfort and energy waste. Augmenting smart thermostats (STs) with per-room sensors has gained acceptance by major ST manufacturers. This paper leverages additional sensory information to empirically characterize the services provided by buildings, including thermal comfort, energy efficiency, and demand response (DR). Utilizing room-level time-series data from 1000 houses, metadata from 110,000 houses across the United States, and data from two real-world testbeds, we examine the limitations of SZMNSs and explore the potential of remote sensors. We discover that comfortable DR durations (CDRDs) for rooms are typically 70% longer or 40% shorter than for the room with the thermostat. When averaging, rooms at the control temperature’s bounds are typically deviated around −3 °F to 2.5 °F from the average. Moreover, in 95% of houses, we identified rooms experiencing notably higher solar gains compared to the rest of the rooms, while 85% and 70% of houses demonstrated lower heat input and poor insulation, respectively. Lastly, it became evident that the consumption of cooling energy escalates with the increase in the number of sensors, whereas heating usage experiences fluctuations ranging from −19% to +25%. This study serves as a benchmark for assessing the thermal comfort and DR services in the existing housing stock, while also highlighting the energy efficiency impacts of sensing technologies. Our approach sets the stage for more granular, precise control strategies of SZMNSs.
abstract_zh: 在单区域多节点系统（SZMNS）中，温度控制依赖于恒温器附近的单一探头，由此产生的温度偏差会导致热舒适性下降和能源浪费。为智能恒温器（ST）配备每个房间的传感器，已得到主要智能恒温器制造商的认可。本文利用额外的感知信息，对建筑物所提供的服务进行实证刻画，包括热舒适、能源效率和需求响应（DR）。利用来自1000户住宅的房间级时间序列数据、来自美国11万户住宅的元数据以及两个实际测试平台的数据，我们考察了单区域多节点系统的局限性，并探讨了远程传感器的潜力。我们发现，各房间的舒适需求响应时长（CDRD）通常比装有恒温器的房间长70%或短40%。取平均值后，控制温度上下限附近的房间通常偏离平均值约为−3 °F至2.5 °F。此外，在95%的住宅中，我们发现有些房间的太阳得热明显高于其他房间；而在85%和70%的住宅中，分别存在较低的热量输入和较差的保温性能。最后，结果显示，制冷能耗随传感器数量的增加而上升，而供暖能耗则在−19%至+25%之间波动。本研究为评估现有住房存量中的热舒适与需求响应服务提供了基准，同时也凸显了传感技术对能源效率的影响。我们的方法为单区域多节点系统实现更精细、更精准的控制策略奠定了基础。

title: A Unifying Approach to Measuring Climate Impacts and Adaptation
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We develop a unifying approach to estimating climate impacts and adaptation, and apply it to study the impact of climate change on local air pollution. Economic agents are usually constrained when responding to daily weather shocks, but may adjust to long- run climatic changes. By exploiting simultaneously variation in weather and climatic changes, we identify both the short- and long-run impacts on economic outcomes, and measure adaptation directly as the difference between those responses. As a result, we identify adaptation without making extrapolations of weather responses over time or space, and overcome prior studies’ biases in the estimates of climate adaptation.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估计气候影响与适应的统一方法，并将其应用于研究气候变化对当地空气污染的影响。经济主体在应对日常天气冲击时通常受到约束，但可以适应长期的气候变化。通过同时利用天气变化与气候变化的差异，我们识别了短期和长期对经济结果的影响，并将适应直接度量为这两类反应之间的差值。因此，我们无需对天气反应在时间或空间上进行外推即可识别适应，并克服了以往研究在估计气候适应时存在的偏差。

title: Does LEED Certification Save Energy? Evidence from Federal Buildings
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: In the absence of first-best climate policy, energy efficiency has figured prominently among strategies to reduce carbon emissions. One of the most sought-after green certification in the building sector is the internationally recognized Leadership in Energy & Environmental Design (LEED). This paper examines the effects of LEED certification on energy efficiency in federally owned buildings. Using propensity score matching and difference in differences models, we find no effect of LEED certification on average energy consumption. This reflects the fact that energy use is one of a number of attributes that receives scores under the LEED program. Buildings with above average energy scores have greater energy efficiency post-certification. Some other attributes, notably higher water scores, decrease energy efficiency post-certification. Trade-offs across LEED attributes account for the absence of energy savings on average. If energy efficiency is the primary policy goal, LEED certification may not be the most effective means to reach that goal.
abstract_zh: 在缺乏最优气候政策的情况下，提高能源效率已成为减少碳排放的主要策略之一。建筑领域最受追捧的绿色认证之一是国际公认的能源与环境设计先锋（LEED）认证。本文考察了LEED认证对联邦政府所有建筑能源效率的影响。利用倾向得分匹配和双重差分模型，我们发现LEED认证对平均能源消耗没有影响。这反映出，能源使用只是LEED项目中获得评分的众多属性之一。能源评分高于平均水平的建筑在获得认证后能源效率有所提高。而另一些属性，尤其是较高的水资源评分，则会在认证后降低能源效率。LEED各属性之间的权衡取舍是平均而言未出现节能效果的原因。如果提高能源效率是首要政策目标，那么LEED认证或许并非实现该目标的最有效手段。

title: Incidental Adaptation: The Role of Non-Climate Regulations
abstract: When a non-climate institution, policy, or regulation corrects a pre-existing market failure that would be exacerbated by climate change, it may also incidentally induce climate adaptation. This regulation-induced adaptation can have large positive welfare effects. We develop a tractable analytical framework of a corrective regulation where the market failure interacts with climate, highlighting the mechanism of regulation-induced adaptation: reductions in the climate-exacerbated effects of pre-existing market failures. We demonstrate this empirically for the US from 1980 to 2013, showing that ambient ozone concentrations increase with rising temperatures, but that such increase is attenuated in counties that are out of attainment with the Clean Air Act’s ozone standards. Adaptation in nonattainment counties reduced the impact of a 1 °C increase in climate normal temperature on ozone concentration by 0.64 parts per billion, or about one-third of the total impact. Over half of that effect was induced by the standard, implying a regulation-induced welfare benefit of $412–471 million per year by mid-century under current warming projections.
abstract_zh: 当一项非气候类制度、政策或法规纠正了一个会因气候变化而加剧的既有市场失灵时，它也可能附带地诱发气候适应。这种由监管诱发的适应可以产生较大的正向福利效应。我们构建了一个可处理的矫正性监管分析框架，其中市场失灵与气候相互作用，并突出了监管诱发适应的机制：既有市场失灵因气候而加剧的效应得以减弱。我们利用1980至2013年的美国数据对此进行了实证检验，结果表明，环境臭氧浓度随气温上升而增加，但在未达到《清洁空气法》臭氧标准的县，这一增加幅度有所减弱。在未达标县，适应使气候常态温度每上升1 °C对臭氧浓度的影响减少了0.64十亿分率（ppb），约占总影响的三分之一。其中一半以上的效应是由该标准诱发的，这意味着在当前变暖预测下，到本世纪中叶，该监管每年可带来4.12亿至4.71亿美元的福利收益。

title: The Power of Hydroelectric Dams: Historical Evidence from the United States over the 20th Century
Timing Matters: Shifting Economic Activity and Intra-day Variation in Ambient Ozone Concentrations
abstract: Ground-level ozone has been shown to have significant health consequences from short-term exposure, and as such has been regulated in the U.S. since the 1970s by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Ozone is not emitted directly; instead formation occurs due to a complex, Leontief-like combination of air pollutants and sunlight that results in high levels mid-day and low levels at night. Despite this known relationship, EPA regulations only consider the total emissions of ozone precursors and not when these emissions occur. Using hourly data on ambient ozone from 1980-2017 near the U.S. time zone borders, we provide evidence that the 1-hour time difference on either side of a border leads to a nontrivial change in ozone levels over the course of the day. We then examine a cap-and-trade program targeting ozone precursor emissions – the NOx Budget Program – finding that while it reduced ozone overall it did not have an economically significant effect on shifting when these emissions occurred. We conclude by outlining a possible policy solution to account for the time value of reductions in precursor emissions.
abstract_zh: 地表臭氧的短期暴露已被证明会对健康产生重大影响，因此自20世纪70年代起，美国环境保护署（EPA）便对其实行监管。臭氧并非直接排放，而是由多种空气污染物与阳光经过复杂的、类似里昂惕夫式的组合反应生成，从而导致其在正午时分浓度较高、夜间浓度较低。尽管存在这一已知关系，EPA的法规仅考虑臭氧前体物的总排放量，而不考虑这些排放发生的时间。利用1980至2017年美国时区边界附近的逐小时环境臭氧数据，我们发现，边界两侧1小时的时差会导致一天中臭氧浓度发生不可忽略的变化。随后，我们考察了一项针对臭氧前体物排放的总量控制与交易计划——NOx预算计划。结果发现，该计划虽然总体上降低了臭氧浓度，但并未在经济上显著改变这些排放发生的时间。最后，我们概述了一种可能的政策方案，以考虑前体物减排在时间上的价值。

title: Assortative Matching or Exclusionary Hiring? The Impact of Firm Policies on Racial Wage Differences in Brazil
Climate-Induced Tradeoffs in Planning and Operating Costs of a Regional Electricity System
abstract: Electricity grid planners design the system to supply electricity to end-users reliably and affordably. Climate change threatens both objectives through potentially compounding supply- and demand-side climate-induced impacts. Uncertainty surrounds each of these future potential impacts. Given long planning horizons, system planners must weigh investment costs against operational costs under this uncertainty. Here, we developed a comprehensive and coherent integrated modeling framework combining physically based models with cost-minimizing optimization models in the power system. We applied this modeling framework to analyze potential tradeoffs in planning and operating costs in the power grid due to climate change in the Southeast U.S. in 2050. We find that planning decisions that do not account for climate-induced impacts would result in a substantial increase in social costs associated with loss of load. These social costs are a result of under-investment in new capacity and capacity deratings of thermal generators when we included climate change impacts in the operation stage. These results highlight the importance of including climate change effects in the planning process.
abstract_zh: 电网规划者的目标是可靠、经济地为终端用户供电。气候变化可能通过供给侧和需求侧的叠加性气候影响，同时威胁这两个目标。这些潜在未来影响均存在不确定性。鉴于规划期限很长，系统规划者必须在这种不确定性下权衡投资成本与运营成本。在此，我们构建了一个全面且连贯的综合建模框架，将基于物理过程的模型与电力系统中的成本最小化优化模型结合起来。我们应用该框架分析了2050年美国东南部地区因气候变化而导致的电网规划与运营成本之间的潜在权衡。我们发现，若规划决策未考虑气候引发的影响，将导致因负荷损失而产生的社会成本大幅上升。这些社会成本源于新增容量投资不足，以及在运营阶段纳入气候变化影响时火电机组出力折减。这些结果凸显了在规划过程中纳入气候变化影响的重要性。

title: Effects of Climate Change on Capacity Expansion Decisions of an Electricity Generation Fleet in the Southeast U.S
abstract: The electric power sector in the United States faces many challenges related to climate change. On the demand side, climate change could shift demand patterns due to increased air temperatures. On the supply side, climate change could lead to deratings of thermal units due to changes in air temperature, water temperature, and water availability. Past studies have typically analyzed these risks separately. Here, we developed an integrated, multimodel framework to analyze how compounding risks of climate-change impacts on demand and supply affect long-term planning decisions in the power system. In the southeast U.S., we found that compounding climate-change impacts could result in a 35% increase in installed capacity by 2050 relative to the reference case. Participation of renewables, particularly solar, in the fleet increased, driven mostly by the expected increase in summertime peak demand. Such capacity requirements would increase investment costs by approximately 31 billion (USD 2015) over the next 30 years, compared to the reference case. These changes in investment decisions align with carbon emission mitigation strategies, highlighting how adaptation and mitigation strategies can converge.
abstract_zh: 美国电力部门面临诸多与气候变化相关的挑战。在需求侧，气温升高可能改变用电需求模式。在供给侧，气温、水温及水资源可得性的变化可能导致火电机组出力折减。以往研究通常分别分析这些风险。在此，我们构建了一个综合的多模型框架，以分析气候变化对需求与供给的叠加性风险如何影响电力系统的长期规划决策。在美国东南部地区，我们发现，叠加性的气候变化影响可能使2050年的装机容量比参照情景增加35%。发电机组中可再生能源（尤其是太阳能）的比重有所上升，这主要由夏季峰值需求的预期增长所驱动。与参照情景相比，这一容量需求将在未来30年内使投资成本增加约310亿美元（2015年美元）。这些投资决策的变化与碳减排战略相一致，凸显了适应与减缓策略可以趋于一致。

title: Placebo Tests" for the Impacts of Air Pollution on Health: The Challenge of Limited Healthcare Infrastructure
abstract: "Placebo tests" are normally used to support evidence of pollution impacts on health outcomes. In this study, we argue that one should be cautious to proceed with falsification tests. We examine how a large metropolitan area in Brazil copes with increased health-care demand due to high air pollution under hospital capacity constraints. Using wind as an instrument, we find that the pollution exposure increases pediatric hospitalization for respiratory diseases while the number of planned procedures decreases in public hospitals. On average, for every four additional pollution-related admissions, one elective care procedure is displaced. Urgent procedures are not displaced.
abstract_zh: “安慰剂检验”通常被用来为污染对健康结果的影响提供证据。在本研究中，我们认为应当谨慎对待证伪检验。我们考察了巴西一个大都市区在医院床位容量受限的条件下，如何应对因空气污染严重而增加的医疗需求。以风速作为工具变量，我们发现污染暴露会增加儿童因呼吸系统疾病而住院的人数，同时公立医院的择期手术数量减少。平均而言，每增加四例与污染相关的入院，就会挤占一例择期诊疗。急诊手术则不受影响。

title: Toxic Truth: Lead and Fertility
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Using U.S county level data on lead in air for 1978-1988, this paper provides the first causal evidence on the effects of airborne lead exposure on the general fertility rate and the completed fertility rate in the broad population. Instrumental variable estimates show the increase in completed fertility implied by the average observed decrease in airborne lead is 0.14 children per woman, which is 6.4 percent of mean fertility. To explore the current relevance of our findings, we estimate the effect of lead historically accumulated in topsoil on fertility in the 2000s.The results suggest that lead may continue to impair fertility today, both in the United States and in other countries that have significant amounts of lead in topsoil.
abstract_zh: 利用1978至1988年美国县级空气铅浓度数据，本文首次提供了空气铅暴露对普通人群一般生育率和完成生育率影响的因果证据。工具变量估计结果显示，平均观测到的空气铅浓度下降所隐含的完成生育率增幅为每位女性0.14个孩子，相当于平均生育率的6.4%。为探讨这些发现的当代相关性，我们估计了2000年代表土中历史累积的铅对生育率的影响。结果表明，铅可能至今仍在损害生育能力，这既适用于美国，也适用于其他表土中铅含量较高的国家。

title: Using Machine Learning to Predict Retrofit Effects for a Commercial Building Portfolio
Considering the Nuclear Option: Hidden Benefits and Internalized Social Costs of Nuclear Power in the U.S. Since 1970
Short- and Long-Run Impacts of Rural Electrification: Evidence from the Rollout of the U.S. Power Grid
Seasonal Effects of Climate Change on Intra-day Electricity Demand Patterns
The Legacy Lead Deposition in Soils and Its Impact on Cognitive Function in Preschool-Aged Children in the United States
The Unintended Impact of Ecosystem Preservation on Greenhouse Gas Emissions: Evidence from Environmental Constraints on Hydropower Development in the United States
abstract: Many countries have passed environmental laws aiming at preserving natural ecosystems, such as the Endangered Species Act of 1973 in the United States. Although those regulations seem to have improved preservation, they may have had unintended consequences in energy production. Here we show that while environmental constraints on hydropower may have preserved the wilderness and wildlife by restricting the development of hydroelectric projects, they led to more greenhouse gas emissions. Environmental regulations gave rise to a replacement of hydropower, which is a renewable, relatively low-emitting source of energy, with conventional fossil-fuel power, which is highly polluting. Our estimates indicate that, on average, each megawatt of fossil fuel power-generating capacity added to the grid because of environmental constraints on hydropower development led to an increase in annual carbon dioxide emissions of about 1,400 tons. Environmental regulations focusing only on the preservation of ecosystems appear to have encouraged electric utilities to substitute dirtier fuels for hydropower in electricity generation.
abstract_zh: 许多国家都通过了旨在保护自然生态系统的环境法律，例如美国1973年的《濒危物种法》。尽管这些法规似乎改善了生态保护，但它们可能在能源生产方面产生了意料之外的后果。在此，我们证明，虽然对水电的环境约束通过限制水电项目的开发，保护了荒野和野生动物，但它们也导致了更多的温室气体排放。环境法规促使水电（一种可再生、排放相对较低的能源）被传统化石燃料发电（污染性很强）所取代。我们的估计表明，平均而言，因水电开发受环境约束而增加并入电网的每兆瓦化石燃料发电容量，会使每年的二氧化碳排放量增加约1400吨。仅关注生态系统保护的环境法规，似乎促使电力公司以较脏的燃料替代水电用于发电。

title: What Explains Cross-City Variation in Mortality during the 1918 Influenza Pandemic? Evidence from 440 U.S. Cities
A Retrospective Analysis of the Market Price Response to Distributed Photovoltaic Generation in California
Pollution, Infectious Disease, and Mortality: Evidence from the 1918-1919 Spanish Influenza Pandemic
abstract: The 1918 Influenza Pandemic killed millions worldwide and hundreds of thousands in the United States. This article studies the impact of air pollution on pandemic mortality. The analysis combines a panel dataset on infant and all-age mortality with a novel measure of air pollution based on the burning of coal in a large sample of U.S. cities. We estimate that air pollution contributed significantly to pandemic mortality. Cities that used more coal experienced tens of thousands of excess deaths in 1918 relative to cities that used less coal with similar pre-pandemic socioeconomic conditions and baseline health. Factors related to poverty, public health, and the timing of onset also affected pandemic mortality. The findings support recent medical evidence on the link between air pollution and influenza infection, and suggest that poor air quality was an important cause of mortality during the pandemic.
abstract_zh: 1918年流感大流行在全球夺去了数百万人的生命，在美国也造成了数十万人死亡。本文研究了空气污染对大流行死亡率的影响。分析结合了婴儿及全年龄段死亡率的面板数据，以及一种基于大量美国城市煤炭燃烧情况构建的空气污染新指标。我们估计，空气污染对大流行死亡率有显著贡献。与大流行前社会经济条件和基线健康状况相似、但煤炭使用较少的城市相比，煤炭使用较多的城市在1918年经历了数以万计的超额死亡。贫困、公共卫生以及疫情开始时间等因素也影响了大流行死亡率。这些发现支持了近期关于空气污染与流感感染之间联系的医学证据，并表明糟糕的空气质量是大流行期间死亡的重要原因。

title: ‘Ticking Bomb’: The Impact of Climate Change on the Incidence of Lyme Disease
venue: Canadian Journal of Infectious Diseases and Medical Microbiology
abstract: Lyme disease (LD) is the most common tick-borne disease in North America. It is caused by Borrelia burgdorferi and transmitted to humans by blacklegged ticks, Ixodes scapularis. The life cycle of the LD vector, I. scapularis, usually takes two to three years to complete and goes through three stages, all of which are dependent on environmental factors. Increases in daily average temperatures, a manifestation of climate change, might have contributed to an increase in tick abundance via higher rates of tick survival. Additionally, these environmental changes might have contributed to better host availability, which is necessary for tick feeding and life cycle completion. In fact, it has been shown that both tick activity and survival depend on temperature and humidity. In this study, we have examined the relationship between those climatic variables and the reported incidence of LD in 15 states that contribute to more than 95% of reported cases within the Unites States. Using fixed effects analysis for a panel of 468 U.S. counties from those high-incidence states with annual data available for the period 2000–2016, we have found sizable impacts of temperature on the incidence of LD. Those impacts can be described approximately by an inverted U-shaped relationship, consistent with patterns of tick survival and host-seeking behavior. Assuming a 2°C increase in annual average temperature—in line with mid-century (2036–2065) projections from the latest U.S. National Climate Assessment (NCA4)—we have predicted that the number of LD cases in the United States will increase by over 20 percent in the coming decades. These findings may help improving preparedness and response by clinicians, public health professionals, and policy makers, as well as raising public awareness of the importance of being cautious when engaging in outdoor activities.
abstract_zh: 莱姆病（LD）是北美最常见的蜱传疾病。它由伯氏疏螺旋体（Borrelia burgdorferi）引起，并通过黑腿蜱（Ixodes scapularis）传播给人类。莱姆病媒介黑腿蜱的生命周期通常需要两到三年才能完成，并经历三个阶段，每个阶段都依赖于环境因素。日均气温升高是气候变化的表现，可能通过提高蜱虫存活率而导致其数量增加。此外，这些环境变化可能提高了宿主的可得性，而宿主对蜱虫取食和完成生命周期是必不可少的。事实上，已有研究表明，蜱虫的活动和存活都取决于温度和湿度。在本研究中，我们考察了上述气候变量与美国15个州报告的莱姆病发病率之间的关系，这些州的病例数占全美报告病例的95%以上。利用来自高发病率州468个美国县在2000至2016年间的年度面板数据进行固定效应分析，我们发现温度对莱姆病发病率有显著影响。这些影响大致可以用倒U形关系来描述，这与蜱虫存活和寻找宿主的行为模式相一致。假设年平均气温上升2°C（与第四次美国国家气候评估（NCA4）对本世纪中叶（2036至2065年）的预测一致），我们预测美国的莱姆病病例数在未来几十年将增加超过20%。这些发现可能有助于临床医生、公共卫生专业人员和政策制定者改进防范与应对工作，同时也提醒公众在户外活动时应当保持谨慎。

title: Impacts of Nuclear Plant Shutdown on Coal-fired Power Generation and Infant Health in the Tennessee Valley in the 1980s
The Local Socio-Economic Impacts of Large Hydropower Plant Development in a Developing Country
The Social Lifecycle Impacts of Power Plant Siting in the Historical United States
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper examines the relative contributions of siting decisions and post-siting demo-graphic shifts to current disparities in exposure to polluting fossil-fuel plants in the United States. Our analysis leverages newly digitized data on power plant siting and operations from 1900-2020, combined with spatially resolved demographics and population data from the U.S Census from 1870-2020.We find little evidence that fossil-fuel plants were disproportionately sited in counties with higher Black population shares on average. However, event study estimates indicate that Black population share grows in the decades after the first fossil-fuel plant is built in a county, with average increases in Black population share of 4 percentage points in the 50-70 years after first siting. These long-run demographic shifts are driven by counties that first hosted a fossil-fuel plant between 1900-1949.We close by exploring how these long-run demographic shifts were shaped by the Great Migration, differential sorting in response to pollution, and other factors. Our findings highlight that the equity implications of siting long-lived infrastructure can differ dramatically depending on the time span considered.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了选址决策与选址后的人口结构变化，各自对当前美国民众接触化石燃料污染电厂之程度的差异所作的相对贡献。我们的分析利用了新数字化的1900至2020年电厂选址与运营数据，并结合了1870至2020年美国人口普查中具有空间分辨率的人口统计与人口数据。我们发现，平均而言，几乎没有证据表明化石燃料电厂被不成比例地建在黑人人口比例较高的县。然而，事件研究估计结果表明，在一个县首座化石燃料电厂建成后的数十年间，黑人人口比例会上升，在选址后50至70年间，平均增加4个百分点。这些长期的人口结构变化主要由1900至1949年间首次建有化石燃料电厂的县所驱动。最后，我们探讨了这些长期人口变化如何受到大迁徙（Great Migration）、对污染的差异化分选以及其他因素的影响。我们的研究结果表明，长寿命基础设施选址的公平性影响，可能会因所考虑的时间跨度不同而产生巨大差异。

title: The Hidden Toll of Airborne Lead: Infant Mortality Impacts of Industrial Lead Pollution
abstract: This paper uses U.S. Toxic Release Inventory data on industrial air lead emissions to provide IV estimates of the effects of air lead concentration on infant mortality. The causal effect of lead on infant mortality is identified by annual variation in air fugitive lead emissions interacted with wind speed near reporting plants, which together determine local ambient lead concentration. Unlike stack emissions, which occur routinely and may prompt avoidance behavior, fugitive emissions are intermittent and influenced by both historical and current factors, such as wind speed variation, making them difficult to avoid. The paper has two main findings. First, higher air lead concentration causes higher infant mortality in the first month and in the first year, suggesting that both in utero and environmental exposures matter. Second, higher lead concentration increases deaths from low birthweight, sudden unexplained infant death (SUID), and respiratory and nervous system causes, which is consistent with findings from animal studies, even when accounting for behavioral responses. Back of the envelope calculations indicate that declines in industrial air lead emissions prevented more than 300 infant deaths per year, generating benefots of at least $3.5 billion annually in 2023 dollars.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国有毒物质排放清单（TRI）中关于工业空气铅排放的数据，通过工具变量估计了空气铅浓度对婴儿死亡率的影响。空气铅对婴儿死亡率的因果效应，由空气中无组织铅排放的逐年变化与报告工厂附近风速的交互项识别，二者共同决定了当地环境铅浓度。与日常持续发生并可能引发规避行为的烟囱排放不同，无组织排放是间歇性的，并受历史与当前因素（如风速变化）的共同影响，因而难以规避。本文有两项主要发现。第一，较高的空气铅浓度会导致出生后第一个月和第一年的婴儿死亡率上升，这表明子宫内暴露和环境暴露均很重要。第二，即使考虑了行为反应，较高的铅浓度仍会增加因低出生体重、婴儿猝死综合征（SUID）以及呼吸和神经系统原因导致的死亡，这与动物实验的研究结果一致。粗略测算表明，工业空气铅排放的下降每年避免了300多例婴儿死亡，并按2023年美元计算，至少产生了每年35亿美元的收益。

title: Behavioral Fatigue and the Reliability Contribution of Residential Time of Use Pricing
abstract: The responsiveness of customers to residential time of use (TOU) rates may be susceptible to fatigue, or a decline in the rates’ effectiveness in reducing demand over time. No study has considered the role of fatigue on the reliability contribution—that is, demand reduction capabilities during high-risk hours--of TOU rates. We examine TOU rates impact on the changes in demand associated with six residential California TOU rates on days when the grid operator called reliability events using a triple difference analysis and the electricity consumption data of thousands of customers from 2020 to 2022. We find that the TOU rates are associated with substantial savings during reliability events, with fatigue only occurring in 16% of on-peak hours of the day across all samples. When fatigue occurred, it was associated with a median of a 32% reduction in savings and rarely led to a complete loss in savings. While TOU rates are effective at reducing demand, the high reduction in savings from fatigue creates uncertainty in reliability contribution.
abstract_zh: 居民对分时电价（TOU）的反应可能出现疲劳，即随着时间推移，电价降低需求的效果逐渐减弱。目前尚无研究考察疲劳对分时电价的可靠性贡献的影响，即在高风险时段内降低需求的能力。我们利用2020至2022年数千名用户的用电数据，在电网运营商宣布可靠性事件的日子里，采用三重差分分析法，考察了六种加州居民分时电价对需求变化的影响。我们发现，分时电价在可靠性事件期间与可观的节省相关，且在所有样本中，疲劳现象仅出现在当天16%的峰时时段。一旦出现疲劳，其与节省量中位数减少32%相关，且很少导致节省完全消失。尽管分时电价在降低需求方面是有效的，但疲劳导致的节省大幅减少，给可靠性贡献带来了不确定性。

title: Carbon Taxation and Firm Behaviour in Emerging Economies: Evidence from South Africa
abstract: This paper provides the first comprehensive analysis of how firms in emerging economies respond to carbon taxation, leveraging detailed administrative data from South Africa—a potential trailblazer for other developing countries with limited state capacity amid the growing global push for carbon pricing. We examine the dynamic impacts of the carbon tax on firm-level outcomes—such as profits, sales, capital, and labour inputs—across manufacturing and mining firms, which are key sectors in the context of the carbon tax. Contrary to concerns that carbon taxes may hinder economic growth or reduce employment, our findings show no evidence of negative average impacts on firm performance or jobs. However, this overall result masks significant heterogeneity in the tax’s effects across sectors, driven by the sector-specific design elements of the South African carbon tax. Firms expecting higher effective tax rates may have intensified their use of emission-intensive machinery and depreciated capital in anticipation of the tax. This behaviour appears to stem from firms resolving regulatory uncertainty or seeking to recover costs from stranded assets.
abstract_zh: 本文首次全面分析了新兴经济体中企业如何应对碳税。研究利用了南非的详细行政数据。南非可能成为其他国家（尤其是国家能力有限的发展中国家）的先行者，而这些国家在全球推行碳定价的背景下正日益关注碳税问题。我们考察了碳税对企业层面结果（如利润、销售额、资本和劳动投入）的动态影响，样本涵盖制造业和采矿业企业，这两个行业是碳税的关键领域。与碳税可能阻碍经济增长或减少就业的担忧相反，我们的研究发现，碳税对企业绩效或就业并无负面的平均影响。然而，这一总体结果掩盖了碳税效应在各行业之间的显著异质性，这一异质性源于南非碳税中针对特定行业的设计要素。预期实际税率较高的企业，可能在预期征税的情况下加大了对高排放机械的使用，并加速了资本折旧。这种行为似乎源于企业为消除监管不确定性或试图回收可能成为搁浅资产的成本。

title: Climate Change Will Unravel Air Quality Regulations
abstract: Using daily data for the United States over the period 1980-2019, we estimate the impacts of temperature on ambient ozone concentrations, accounting for adaptation to climatic change. We find that even with adaptation, rises in temperature will steeply increase ozone levels by over 9 ppb on days above 25◦C. By mid-century, we calculate that 189 additional counties will be violating the air quality standards, with 33 million more residents exposed to unhealthy levels of ozone. Climate change will thus put the ambient ozone standards at risk as the costs of compliance with existing standards will likely increase. In light of a recent EPA ruling that would effectively remove co-benefits from ozone precursor reductions from the cost-benefit analysis of those standards, they will be in peril.
abstract_zh: 利用1980至2019年美国的日度数据，并考虑到对气候变化的适应，我们估计了气温对环境臭氧浓度的影响。我们发现，即使存在适应，气温上升仍将使日均气温高于25°C的日子里臭氧浓度急剧上升超过9 ppb。到本世纪中叶，我们计算出将有189个额外的县违反空气质量标准，还将有3300万居民暴露于不健康的臭氧水平。因此，气候变化将使环境臭氧标准面临风险，因为满足现行标准的成本很可能上升。鉴于美国环保署近期的一项裁定将实际上剔除臭氧前体物减排的协同效益，从这些标准的成本收益分析中剔除，这些标准的前景将岌岌可危。

title: Health Shocks under Hospital Capacity Constraint:Evidence from Air Pollution in Sao Paulo, Brazil
abstract: When a health shock hits a location, the healthcare infrastructure needs to be adjusted to meet the increased demand. This may be a challenge in developing countries because of limited hospital capacity. In this study, we examine the consequences of health shocks induced by air pollution in a megacity in the developing world: Sao Paulo, Brazil. Using daily data from 2015-2017, and an instrumental variable approach based on wind speed, we provide evidence that exposure to particulate matter (PM10) causes an increase in pediatric hospitalizations for respiratory diseases, which in turn leads to a decrease in hospital admissions for elective care  phimosis surgery and epilepsy-related procedures such as video-EEG (electroencephalograph) monitoring. Importantly, emergency procedures such as appendectomy and bone fracture repair are not affected. While strained Sao Paulo hospitals seem to absorb the increased demand induced by poor air quality, our results imply that the common practice of using health outcomes unrelated to pollution as "placebo tests" in studies on the effects of air pollution might be inadequate in settings with limited healthcare infrastructure. This is often the case in developing countries, where severe pollution is also ubiquitous, but also happens in deprived areas in the developed world.
abstract_zh: 当某一地区遭遇健康冲击时，医疗基础设施需要进行调整以满足增加的需求。在医院床位有限的发展中国家，这可能是一项挑战。在本研究中，我们考察了空气污染所引发的健康冲击在发展中世界的一座特大城市——巴西圣保罗——的后果。利用2015至2017年的日度数据，并采用以风速为工具变量的方法，我们发现，暴露于颗粒物（PM10）会导致儿童因呼吸系统疾病而住院人数增加，进而导致包皮环切术和癫痫相关诊疗（如视频脑电图监测）等择期诊疗的住院人数减少。重要的是，阑尾切除术和骨折修复等急诊手术不受影响。尽管圣保罗的医院似乎能够消化因空气质量恶化而增加的需求，但我们的结果表明，在关于空气污染影响的研究中，常见的做法是使用与污染无关的健康结果作为“安慰剂检验”，而在医疗基础设施有限的环境中，这种做法可能是不充分的。这种情况在发展中国家较为常见，那里的严重污染也十分普遍，但在发达国家的贫困地区同样存在。

title: Impacts of the Clean Air Act on the Power Sector from 1938-1994: Anticipation and Adaptation
abstract: This study leverages newly digitized data on virtually every fossil-fuel power plant in the United States from 1938-1994 to provide the first assessment of the impacts of the 1970 Clean Air Act (CAA) that accounts for anticipation. The extended pre-regulation benchmark allows us to account for anticipatory behavior by electric utilities in the years leading up to the Act's passage. Guided by predictions from a simple theoretical framework, we use a difference-in-differences approach to examine the impacts of the Act's nonattainment designations on coal-fired power plants of different vintages. We find that nonattainment designation led to large and persistent decreases in plant productivity, which would be substantially underestimated without data from well before the passage of the 1970 CAA.The productivity losses were concentrated only among plants built before 1963.This timing aligns with the passage of the original 1963 CAA, which served as a signal of impending federal regulation. We provide empirical and historical evidence of anticipatory responses by utilities in the design and siting of plants that opened after 1963.Finally, we find that the aggregate productivity losses of the CAA borne by the power sector were substantially mitigated by the reallocation of output away from older less productive power plants.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用新数字化的1938至1994年美国几乎所有化石燃料电厂的数据，首次评估了1970年《清洁空气法》（CAA）的影响，并考虑了预期效应。扩展后的法规出台前基准期使我们能够考虑电力公司在该法通过前几年的预期行为。在一个简单理论框架的指导下，我们采用双重差分方法，考察了该法的非达标地区认定对不同建造年代燃煤电厂的影响。我们发现，非达标认定导致了电厂生产率的大幅且持续下降，而如果没有1970年《清洁空气法》通过之前的数据，这种下降将被严重低估。生产率损失仅集中于1963年之前建成的电厂。这一时间点与最初的1963年《清洁空气法》的通过相吻合，该法被视为联邦监管即将到来的信号。我们为电力公司在1963年后开业的电厂的设计与选址中的预期性反应提供了实证和历史证据。最后，我们发现，电力部门承担的《清洁空气法》总体生产率损失，由于产出从老旧低效电厂向其他电厂的再分配而得到了显著缓解。

title: Industrial Activity, State Capacity, and Deforestation: Evidence from Brazil
abstract: Does industrial activity drive deforestation and land degradation, and can limited state capacity be overcome to decouple economic growth from environmental harm? We examine these questions in the context of slaughterhouse plant openings in Brazil from 1994 to 2019. Guided by a simple conceptual framework and using a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we show that plant openings increase livestock production while reducing forest cover and degrading pastureland. However, following the introduction of legally enforceable, incentive-compatible agreements between slaughterhouses and federal prosecutors—which penalize purchases of livestock from illegally deforested areas but act as a green certification mechanism—plant openings increase productivity without driving deforestation. Our findings suggest that tying firm performance to environmental goals through market-aligned legal mechanisms can generate economic and environmental gains at low cost to the government. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 工业活动是否会推动森林砍伐和土地退化？在国家能力有限的情况下，能否克服这一问题，使经济增长与环境损害脱钩？我们在巴西1994至2019年屠宰场开设的背景下考察了这些问题。在一个简单概念框架的指导下，并采用交错双重差分方法，我们发现，屠宰场的开设会增加畜牧业产量，同时减少森林覆盖并使牧场退化。然而，在屠宰场与联邦检察官之间签订了具有法律强制力、激励相容的协议之后——该协议对购买来自非法砍伐地区牲畜的行为进行处罚，同时起到绿色认证机制的作用——屠宰场的开设在提高生产率的同时并未导致森林砍伐。我们的研究结果表明，通过与市场相契合的法律机制将企业绩效与环境目标挂钩，可以在政府付出较低成本的情况下实现经济与环境双重收益。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家居民，可在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Weathering Challenges: Distributional Impacts of Climatic Shocks on Household Consumption in Mozambique
abstract: Mozambique is highly vulnerable to climate change. It faces frequent cyclones, floods, and droughts while having limited revenue collection capacity and social protection programmes. This paper assesses the distributional effects of climate shocks on household consumption and explores adaptation strategies using consumption survey data from 2008 to 2022, combined with district-level climate data. We find that extreme rainfall and dryness shocks during the growing season significantly reduce household expenses for essential goods, with impacts most pronounced at the bottom to the middle of the consumption distribution. However, we found that the consumption of self-produced goods mitigates the expense losses. Our findings suggest that the main social protection programme in the country, PSSB, also helps mitigate these negative effects. We do not find evidence that domestic family transfer and international remittances cushion consumption losses because of climate shocks. This study underscores the importance of developing targeted policies to protect households in vulnerable regions as climate risks intensify.
abstract_zh: 莫桑比克极易受到气候变化的影响。该国经常遭遇气旋、洪水和干旱，同时税收征管能力和社会保护计划都十分有限。本文利用2008至2022年的消费调查数据，结合地区层面的气候数据，评估了气候冲击对家庭消费的分配效应，并探讨了适应策略。我们发现，生长季节的极端降雨和干旱冲击显著减少了家庭在基本商品上的支出，其影响在消费分布的中下层至中间层最为明显。然而，我们发现自产商品的消费减轻了支出损失。我们的研究结果表明，该国主要的社会保护计划PSSB也有助于缓解这些负面影响。我们没有发现证据表明，国内家庭转移支付和国际汇款能够缓冲因气候冲击导致的消费损失。本研究强调，随着气候风险加剧，制定有针对性的政策以保护脆弱地区的家庭至关重要。
